title: extraction_item
description: One structured item extracted from a single raw system response file (one system/task/hospital/run).

item_index.description: 0-based index of this item within its source file's items list.

hospital.description: Hospital name exactly as named in the raw folder structure (not normalised/aliased).

person_or_issue.description: Person's name (CEO/supervisor/board tasks) or the issue name (PHIPA task), copied as stated in the response.

role.description: Title/role as stated in the response, verbatim. Null if not stated.

date_raw.description: Date exactly as it appears in the response text. Null if no date given.

date_normalised.description: Normalised date. One of YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY, or null if date_raw is null or unparseable.

citation_url.description: URL exactly as given in the response. Null if no link was provided. Never invented.

citation_text.description: Source/publication name or anchor text tied to the citation, if given. Null if none.

verbatim_snippet.description: The exact sentence(s) from the response this item was extracted from. Copied verbatim, not paraphrased.

file_level_schema.description: Each /output/extracted/*.json file (one per system/task/hospital/run) has this shape.

source_file.description: Relative path of the raw file this was extracted from.

refusals.description: List of hospitals/entries for which the response explicitly stated it could not find information. Each entry: {hospital, refusal_text}.
